items.text: Our recent work on H2O2 production has been featured on YTN Science!
Hyekyung started her independent career as a senior researcher at the ADD! Huge congrats!
Bolormaa successfully defended her PhD dissertation and received the best award among UST graduates! She's pursuing her career at the MPIP Mainz. All the best!
items.home_text: Bolormaa defended her PhD dissertation and received the best award among UST graduates!

items.text: Farewell to Sunil! It was an amazing 3 years to work with him. He's moving to GWNU in Gangneung.
Jeehye was selected as KIST's best researcher of the year! Congratulations!
Our work in Angew. Chem. was featured as an Inside Cover! Congratulations!
Our work won the best paper award from the Korean Society on Water Environment.
Jeehye received the KIST researcher of the month award for our recent work in EES! Congratulations!
Jeehye gave an invited talk at the 1st Rising Researcher Workshop of the Korean Society of Environmental Engineering.
Bolormaa was selected as a KIST-KT&G scholarship recipient. Congratulations!
Our work in EES was highlighted as a Front Cover! Congratulations!
Bolormaa won the best presentation award at the 2022 UST Academic Workshop! Congratulations!
Dr. Sunil Kumar won a prestigious Brain Pool fellowship for 3 years, focusing on a new fabrication protocol for conjugated polymer thin films.
Jeehye gave an invited talk at the Korean Electrochemical Society 2022 Spring Meeting.
Yejin and Hyejeong successfully finished their internship at KIST!
We bid farewell to Yeongran! Wishing you the best of luck with your career :)
Postdoc position (closed)
We won the convergence research funding from the NST. Joint research with Korea University and KISTI will be launched.
Welcome Yejin and Hyejeong to the KIST internship program!
Welcome on board! Dr. Yeongran Hong joined the team.
We won the prestigious A-star funding from the NRF. Our photocatalytic H₂O₂ production study will continue for 3 years.

Our research on the photocatalytic membrane was featured in various online media: [Hankyung](https://www.hankyung.com/it/article/2020111039657), [Yonhap](https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20201109036500017), [Science Times](https://www.sciencetimes.co.kr/news/%ED%96%87%EB%B3%95-%EC%AC%90%EB%A9%B4-%EC%9E%90%EB%8F%99-%EC%84%B8%EC%B2%99%EA%B3%A0%ED%9A%A8%EC%9C%A8-%EA%B4%91%EC%B4%89%EB%A7%A4-%EC%88%98%EC%B2%98%EB%A6%AC-%EB%B6%84%EB%A6%AC%EB%A7%89/), [Water Journal](http://www.waterjournal.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=52849), [Seoul Economic Daily](https://www.sedaily.com/NewsVIew/1ZACRYH3MN), [Innovations Report](https://www.innovations-report.com/power-and-electrical-engineering/let-the-sunshine-in-self-cleaning-membrane-under-visible-light-treatment/), [EurekAlert](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/749295).
